threads.body:
Use a named constant:
```suggestion
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
```

instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing.

For every `[suggestion]` thread under `## Review threads`, run one `pr-shepherd build-suggestion-patches https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --thread-id "<id>" --message "<one-sentence headline>" --format=json`, repeating `--thread-id` and `--message` in displayed order. Playbook: "Suggestion patches".
Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch before review mutations.
Journal substantial decisions or rejections, citing item URLs or review IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_suggest_conflict --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. Rerun the same command now.
